== Players Committee forum (forum.starwarsccg.org) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
New page from posts on the Players Committee forum. Topics used: 20909, 20869, 21635, 22883.
The cited posts are live forum.starwarsccg.org posts; they have no Internet Archive capture yet (forum snapshots are to be added later), so the refs carry no Preserved copy for now.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Michael Richards listed himself as first (t20869 p317096, a post body, not a signature), but the two Day 2 bids went to Bryan Batdorf and Blake Huffman, with Huffman's report titled second place. Richards already held a 2008 bid from the MPC consolation event (t22883), which would explain the bids passing down, but no post says so.

* Michael Richards' card credit for Sy Snootles (V) ("Original concept by Michael Richards, Dantooine Regionals 2008") is on the wiki; it supports the first place.
